page.overview:
What is Solganium Z?

A クリスタル|Zetto-Kurisutaru}} is a special type of item introduced in Generation VII, used to activate a Z-Move. It helps Pokémon use the corresponding Z-Move when equipped with one, as long as it knows a move of the same type.

One Z-Crystal can be used as many times and on as many Pokémon as one wishes. The Z-Crystals work with the Z-Ring.

For a Trainer to obtain Z-Crystal, one must complete an Island Trial challenge by defeating Totem Pokémon and a Grand Trial challenge by defeating the Island Kahuna. The Z-Crystals and the powers of the Totem Pokémon were created by Ultra Necrozma, as a result of losing its light.
